inventory_item_disponible_ck.name: inventory_item_disponible_ck
inventory_item_disponible_ck.value: "inventory_item"."status" <> 'disponible' or ("inventory_item"."sales_point_id" is null and "inventory_item"."reserved_until" is null)

inventory_item_reservada_ck.name: inventory_item_reservada_ck
inventory_item_reservada_ck.value: "inventory_item"."status" <> 'reservada' or ("inventory_item"."sales_point_id" is not null and "inventory_item"."reserved_until" is not null)

sale_void_ck.name: sale_void_ck
sale_void_ck.value: "sale"."status" <> 'anulada' or ("sale"."voided_at" is not null and "sale"."voided_by" is not null)
